spawnerStateReadSemantics: Read-only GetSpawnSystemNames/GetSpawnSystemInfo values; missing API/state is recorded unavailable. Disposable native state wrappers are disposed after each read.
behaviorClassificationBasis: Setter effects are classified from observed component state, VFX batch API fields, particle counts, and captured quilt pixels. API byte fields and process-global memory counters are separate measures; neither is a physical VRAM attribution.
processMemorySemantics: Graphics driver allocation and Unity Editor private/process working-set counters are process-global observations sampled after the VFX-off warm baseline; threshold stop is post-allocation and is not a hard cap or physical VRAM measure.
